facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare's Nigeria Digital Health Architecture (December 2025) states that health data systems remain largely siloed and paper based, especially in public facilities, that patients often rely on physical records, and that where electronic health record systems exist the absence of national standards restricts data sharing.

The Nigeria Digital Health Architecture (December 2025), published by the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare under the Nigeria Digital in Health Initiative approved by the National Council on Health in 2024, sets implementing interoperable electronic health record systems across all levels of care as its first pillar and says rollout will start with the six national EHR vendors; a costed implementation road map is promised, not yet published.
